output.answer: The latest stable Bun release is v1.4.4 — npm's `latest` dist-tag points at 1.4.4 (published 2026-10-26) and GitHub's newest non-prerelease release is bun-v1.4.4 (published 2026-10-22). Its headline is `bun fmt`, a new built-in Prettier-compatible formatter reported at ~286x faster than Prettier on Prettier's own repo (59.7 ms vs 17.1 s) and 3x-6x faster than oxfmt, alongside a much faster `bun check` (up to 7.8x, 15.7x with -b), Yarn Berry (v2+) lockfile migration in `bun install`, lower-CPU SQL (30-48% fewer user-space instructions, query.cancel(), PostgreSQL COPY streams), a native port of `ws` 8.22.0 with Node-matching close/error semantics, a JavaScriptCore upgrade carrying 1,013 WebKit commits (toLocaleString 54x faster), and a broad security-fix batch across TLS, HTTP/1.1-3, WebSocket, Bun.serve/Bun.SQL, node:* modules, fetch and the package manager. It is a patch on the Bun 1.4 line. Status was `ok`; three items remain `unverified` — the truncated tail of the release notes (remaining bugfix entries and any CVE identifiers), the '271 issues fixed' figure, and the Bun 1.4 milestone-post details, which rest on search snippets only.
